title: Bones hold the body up, help it move, and shield organs
summary: NIAMS says bones support and hold up the body, help it move, and protect organs.
body: NIAMS says bones support and hold up the body, help it move, and protect organs. Without them, the page's picture is a squishy shape on the ground. Some of them shield soft organs from injury. Movement uses them together with muscle. This card is those jobs. It gives no disease list and no count of how many there are.

sources.title: Health Lesson: Learning About Bones
sources.author: National Institute of Arthritis and Musculoskeletal and Skin Diseases
sources.note: US government page, public domain. Last Updated June 2025. Supports the support, movement, and protection jobs in the What are bones section. The rib and skull examples are on the page and are not needed for this shorter claim.
